name: icon
title: Icon
description: Renders an icon by abstract name from any of five icon libraries (Lucide, Tabler Icons, HugeIcons, Phosphor Icons, Remix Icon).

props.name: name
props.description: Abstract icon name, e.g. "SearchIcon" — shared across all 5 libraries.

props.name: library
props.description: Which icon library to render from. Defaults to "lucide".

props.name: unsized
props.description:
Suppress the default `size-4` class so the emitted <svg> carries no
`size-*` utility at all.

The 8 style layers size icons through shadcn's vendored
`[&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-N` escape hatch, which only reaches
an <svg> that has NO size class. Upstream shadcn's icon loader emits no
default size for exactly this reason; this component adds `size-4` as a
convenience, which silently disables that hatch. Set `unsized` at any
call site whose size is owned by an ancestor's `mu-*` style rule.

examples.title: Default
examples.source: import Icon from "@marko-ui/shadcn/ui/icon/icon.marko";
examples.description: Renders from the default library (`lucide`) when `library` is omitted.

library>
${ICON_LIBRARIES[library].title}
name>
examples.description: The same abstract `name` renders a different, authentic glyph per `library` — the `name` space (191 names) is shared across all five.
